# RealDays
> Unique experiences run by the local people who started them. In Victoria, Australia and Bali.

RealDays is a booking site for small, owner-run experience businesses. Nothing to join and nothing a month. Until 1 May 2027, businesses pay only the card fee on each booking, about 1.7% plus 30 cents for Australian cards. From 1 May 2027, it's 12% of each booking made through RealDays, with GST and the card fee included. If a booking is refunded in full, so is the fee. Bookings a business takes itself cost nothing. Businesses get at least 60 days' notice of any change and can leave whenever they want.

## Salty Cowboy, Bali
Owner-run horse rescue and riding centre in Bali, run by Simone. 11 experiences: beach and rice field rides, photoshoots, and lessons from grooming to a 3-day Horse Whisperer course. Prices from IDR 1,250,000.
